Product identity and source
The existing product details show entered ingredients, strength, form, routes, CIS/CIP, source version and date. Missing fields remain unknown; matching names do not prove equivalence.
Packaging
Entered CIP identifies a claimed presentation, not verified usable stock. Structured packaging capacity is not available here. No conversion or stock deduction occurs.

Supply, shortages, recalls and regulatory notices
Not implemented. Current availability is unknown; this does not mean normal supply or no recalls. There is no live pharmacy stock lookup.

Status meanings: missing information = no field supplied; unverified = supplied but not checked; unknown = cannot determine; not implemented = no feature available. None means normal supply or safety.
